name: 15063 · Monongahela, PA
findings: ZIP 15063 (Monongahela) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15063 (Monongahela) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15063 (Monongahela) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
